name: Tokudaiji Sanesada
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 81); Porter’s note gives the dates as: took orders 1198.

poems.title: The cuckoo’s echo dies away
poems.author: Tokudaiji Sanesada
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 81
poems.text:
The cuckoo’s echo dies away,
And lo! the branch is bare;
I only see the morning moon,
Whose light is fading there
Before the daylight’s glare.

poems.title: 81. ほととぎす 鳴きつる方を 眺むれば (Hototogisu nakitsuru kata o nagamureba)
poems.author: Tokudaiji Sanesada
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
ほととぎす 鳴きつる方を 眺むれば
ただ有明の 月ぞ残れる
